_comment: Release notes catalogue for the Temveris desktop tracker. Keyed by semver. Edit this file (no code change) when shipping a new build; the /desktop/latest endpoint reads it on every request (cached 60s). If a published version is missing from this file the endpoint falls back to default_notes so the banner never shows an empty bullet list.

notes: Screenshot interval now follows your organization's settings (no longer stuck at 30s)
Fixed screenshots that failed to open in the dashboard and timelapse
Reliable in-app update detection and install
